integrity: All displayed formulas were rederived from the cited L-ADMM update. A standalone checker reconstructs the recurrence and tests exact algebraic identities plus deterministic numerical regressions. Literature comparison distinguishes ordinary ADMM parameter optimization from L-ADMM stabilization tuning.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the symmetric scalar quadratic split and constant stabilization.
The optimized criterion is asymptotic spectral radius, not a finite-horizon norm bound; repeated-root cases may have a polynomial prefactor.
For \(h<1\) the result is an instance-specific direct stability calculation beyond the source paper's general sufficient majorization condition \(\eta\ge L_G\).
No claim is made that the scalar optimum simultaneously optimizes multiple spectral modes.
title: Exact stabilization phase diagram for scalar linearized ADMM
